_about: Freshwater Strategy / AFR issue-importance and issue-management tables, read only from official Datawrapper TSV payloads and the two official December 2022 PNGs. Importance, full three-response management and the four-issue Labor-net-lead supplements are separate measures. Printed labels and source row order are retained, including source spelling/grammar changes. Tabular/chart downloads do not print exact question stems, so only the two PNG-backed December 2022 stems are filed; no stem is inferred for another wave. May 2023, September 2023 and February 2025 are explicit missing-battery markers, never zeros. Nothing here is joined to polls.json.
questionStemPolicy: Do not invent question stems absent from the tabular downloads; questionStem:null means no exact stem was present in the downloaded table or chart shell

universes.importance: Usually 16 printed rows including Other; December 2022 has 15 because its PNG omits job security, and January 2024 has 17 because its TSV adds Indigenous affairs
universes.management: Three response columns over 15 issues in the tabular waves; the December 2022 PNG has those three responses over 14 printed issues because it omits job security
universes.netLeadSupplements: Four issues only, printed Labor-minus-Coalition leads by month; supplement, not full three-response management

importance.measure: share naming the issue among up to three voter priorities

waves.title: Voter priorities
waves.questionStem: Which of the following do you think are the most important issues for the Federal government to focus on at this time? Please pick up to three
waves.sourceNotes: Freshwater Strategy / AFR Poll; Australian voters; Sample size n=1,209; Fieldwork 16-18 Dec 2022; Figures may not sum to 100% due to rounding

source.verification: Solely mechanical: no transcription or model-read pixel figure is used. ocrTable() coordinate-matches each printed issue label and numeric cell independently in accurate-mode 3x and 4x ocr-image.swift outputs. Both scales must return the same issue, response column and share or the build fails; the two scale-specific raw boxes for every shipped cell are in 2022-12-ocr-proof.json.
